subject.title: [Feishu] 飞书群多机器人身份混乱问题

question: Which stable Feishu bot/account discriminator should be part of durable group session identity, and how should existing Feishu group session history be migrated or repaired?
rationale: The fix crosses a persisted session-key and authorization boundary; source review identifies the missing discriminator, but automation cannot safely choose the compatibility and security tradeoff.

options.title: Account-scoped group sessions with migration
options.body: Include the normalized Feishu account boundary in group session identity and provide doctor or migration handling for existing group keys.

options.title: App or bot-identity scoped sessions
options.body: Use a Feishu platform identity such as appId or a proven bot identity if maintainers prefer platform semantics over OpenClaw account ids.

options.title: Defer to broader Feishu identity design
options.body: Keep this open while related Feishu multi-bot mention, context, and DM identity work converge on one shared model.

recommendation.title: Account-scoped group sessions with migration
recommendation.body: Include the normalized Feishu account boundary in group session identity and provide doctor or migration handling for existing group keys.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu group/thread context work and adjacent Feishu identity review make this the best available routing owner for the security-boundary decision.
